about.title: Simchat Dahan
about.subtitle: Founder of Molly's Candle
about.p1: Molly's Candle is a cozy, intimate home boutique studio for designing and making handmade candles.
about.p2: You'll find scented candles in a range of colors, designs and scents: poured candles, candles in vessels and custom-designed candles, for every style, every taste and every purpose.
about.p3: For workshops we come right to you, with a smile, quality materials and plenty of inspiration.
about.quote: Not just candles, but a whole experience of scent, design and calm.
about.imageAlt: Hands decorating a coconut-shell candle with shells

where.q: Where do the workshops take place?
where.a: We come to you: your home, office, event venue or anywhere you choose, with all the tools and materials.

ages.q: What ages are the workshops for?
ages.a: All ages, from kids to adults. We adapt the content and materials to your group.

size.a: We run workshops for individuals and for groups, small and large. Tell us how many you'll be and we'll plan accordingly.

events.q: Can I order candles for an event or as guest favors?
events.a: Absolutely. We design custom candles for weddings, bar and bat mitzvahs, holidays and events, in the colors, scents and design you choose.

price.a: It depends on the type of workshop, the number of participants and the design. Send us a WhatsApp message and we'll get back to you with a tailored quote.

notice.q: How far in advance should I book?
notice.a: As early as you can, especially before holidays and during event season.

cta.title: Want to light up a special moment?
cta.text: Send us a message and we'll get back to you with all the details, no commitment.
